name: @usrp/feature-field-ops
description: Walk-in registration and vetting (RDF only). Device enrolment, offline score sync and conflict resolution are implemented upstream in field-sync-service but have NO edge route yet.
//dependencies: @usrp/api-client supplies the ONE contract-asserted transport. CORRECTED 2026-09-13: the previous note claimed FOUR of this slice's six operations were invented because biometric-service and field-sync-service are both scaffolds. THREE are implemented upstream and verified by file - enroll-device, sync-scores and resolve-conflict controllers in services/field-sync-service/src/adapters/http/. They are unreachable because services/edge-gateway/ holds an OpenAPI document and no runnable service, not because the upstream is missing. Only verifyBiometric remains unverified, and it is recorded as unverified rather than absent. See src/api/transport.ts.
//peerDependencies: React, ReactDOM and the router are PEERS, not dependencies. The host app owns the single instance; a second React in the graph throws 'invalid hook call' and resolves context to the wrong provider. The devDependency copies exist only so this slice typechecks and tests standalone.
